2.26 The powers under Schedule 5 to the Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures Act

2011 and Schedule 11 to the National Security Act 2023 allow a constable to conduct a
search of an individual only for specified purposes relating to a TPIM or STPIM notice as set
out above. However, anything found may be seized and retained if there are reasonable
grounds for believing that it is or it contains evidence of any offence for use at a trial for that
offence or to prevent it being concealed, lost, damaged, altered, or destroyed. However, this
would not prevent a search being carried out under other search powers if, in the course of
exercising these powers, the officer formed reasonable grounds for suspicion.
